series.title: Euro area HICP, all-items, annual rate of change

release.calendar_source: assumption: Eurostat's prc_hicp_minr HICP table posts a reference month's all-items annual rate on/around the first calendar day of the following month — empirically verified on 2026-09-01, when the 2026-08 value was already present in a fresh fetch. grace_days=30 absorbs calendar drift (weekends, holidays, revisions to the release calendar).

vintage_policy: first-published value at first successful fetch on/after release date scores; later revisions never re-open a verdict
